output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potential overflow if initialSupply is very large.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] is incremented by _value without a check, causing a potential overflow if _value is very large.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] is incremented by _value without a check, causing a potential overflow if _value is very large.

output_list.vulnerability: The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is derived from dividing the msg.value by buyPrice without a check, causing a potential overflow if buyPrice is very small.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is multiplied by sellPrice before transferring to msg.sender, causing a potential overflow if sellPrice is very large.
